records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says Yahweh: Ask, please, among the nations, who has heard like these? A horrible thing she has done exceedingly, [the] virgin of Israel.

en.L: Therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q Ask among the nations, \q who has heard [anything] like these [things]? \q The virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.
en.B: Therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q Ask among the nations, \q who has ever heard of such things? \q The virgin Israel has done a most horrible thing.
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q Ask the other nations \q if anyone has ever heard of something like this. \q Israel should be like a pure young woman, \q but she has done something truly horrible.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q {{plural_you:Pregunten|Preguntad}} entre las naciones, \q ¿quién ha oído [cosas] como estas? \q Algo muy horrible ha hecho la virgen de Israel.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q {{plural_you:Pregunten|Preguntad}} entre las naciones: \q ¿Quién ha oído alguna vez cosa semejante? \q La virgen Israel ha hecho algo horrendo.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q {{plural_you:Pregúntenles|Preguntadles}} a las otras naciones \q si alguien ha oído alguna vez algo así. \q Israel debía ser como una joven pura, \q pero ha hecho algo verdaderamente horrible.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Interrogez donc parmi les nations : \q qui a entendu [rien de] pareil ? \q La vierge d’Israël a fait une chose tout à fait horrible.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Renseignez-vous parmi les nations : \q qui a jamais entendu pareille chose ? \q La vierge Israël a commis une horreur.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Demandez aux autres nations \q si quelqu’un a déjà entendu parler d’une chose pareille. \q Israël aurait dû être comme une jeune fille pure, \q mais elle a fait quelque chose de vraiment horrible.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Ulizeni kati ya mataifa, \q ni nani aliyesikia [mambo] kama haya? \q Bikira wa Israeli amefanya jambo la kuchukiza mno.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Ulizeni kati ya mataifa, \q ni nani aliyewahi kusikia mambo kama haya? \q Bikira Israeli amefanya jambo la kutisha mno.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Yaulizeni mataifa mengine \q kama kuna mtu aliyewahi kusikia jambo kama hili. \q Israeli alipaswa kuwa kama msichana safi, \q lakini amefanya jambo la kutisha kweli.

vi.L: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Hãy hỏi giữa các dân tộc, \q ai đã từng nghe [điều gì] giống như những [điều] này? \q Trinh nữ Y-sơ-ra-ên đã làm một điều rất kinh tởm.
vi.B: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Hãy hỏi các dân tộc xem \q ai đã từng nghe những chuyện như thế? \q Trinh nữ Y-sơ-ra-ên đã làm một điều hết sức kinh tởm.
vi.R: Vậy đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Hãy hỏi các dân tộc khác \q xem có ai từng nghe điều gì như thế không. \q Y-sơ-ra-ên lẽ ra phải như một thiếu nữ trong trắng, \q nhưng nàng đã làm một điều thật kinh tởm.

ko.L: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 민족들 가운데 물어보아라. \q 누가 이런 [일들]과 같은 것을 들었느냐? \q 처녀 이스라엘이 아주 끔찍한 일을 저질렀다.
ko.B: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 민족들 가운데 물어보아라. \q 누가 이런 일을 들어 본 적이 있느냐? \q 처녀 이스라엘이 너무나 끔찍한 일을 저질렀다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 다른 민족들에게 물어보아라. \q 누가 이런 일을 들어 본 적이 있는지. \q 이스라엘은 깨끗한 처녀 같아야 했다. \q 그런데 그는 정말 끔찍한 일을 저질렀다.

pt.L: Por isso, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Perguntem entre as nações: \q quem ouviu [algo] como estas [coisas]? \q Uma coisa muito horrível fez a virgem de Israel.
pt.B: Por isso, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Perguntem entre as nações: \q quem já ouviu falar de coisas assim? \q A virgem Israel fez algo horrível demais.
pt.R: Por isso, é isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: \q Perguntem às outras nações \q se alguém já ouviu falar de uma coisa assim. \q Israel devia ser como uma moça pura, \q mas fez uma coisa realmente horrível.

am.L: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ \q በሕዝቦች መካከል ጠይቁ፤ \q እንደዚህ ያለ [ነገር] ማን ሰምቶ ያውቃል? \q የእስራኤል ድንግል እጅግ የሚዘገንን ነገር አድርጋለች።
am.B: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ \q በሕዝቦች መካከል ጠይቁ፤ \q እንዲህ ያለውን ነገር ማን ሰምቶ ያውቃል? \q ድንግሊቱ እስራኤል እጅግ የሚዘገንን ነገር አድርጋለች።
am.R: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ \q ሌሎቹን ሕዝቦች ጠይቁ፤ \q እንዲህ ያለ ነገር የሰማ ሰው ይኖር እንደ ሆነ ጠይቁ። \q እስራኤል እንደ ንጽሕት ወጣት ሴት መሆን ይገባት ነበር፤ \q እርሷ ግን እጅግ የሚዘገንን ነገር አድርጋለች።

hi.L: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: \q जातियों के बीच पूछो, \q ऐसी [बातें] किसने सुनी हैं? \q इस्राएल की कुँवारी ने बहुत ही घिनौना काम किया है।
hi.B: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: \q देश-देश के लोगों से पूछो, \q क्या किसी ने कभी ऐसी बातें सुनी हैं? \q कुँवारी इस्राएल ने अत्यंत घिनौना काम किया है।
hi.R: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: \q दूसरे देशों के लोगों से पूछो \q कि क्या किसी ने कभी ऐसी बात सुनी है। \q इस्राएल को एक पवित्र कुँवारी लड़की जैसा होना चाहिए था, \q पर उसने सचमुच घिनौना काम किया है।

ru.L: Поэтому так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q Спросите же среди народов, \q кто слышал [что-либо] подобное этому? \q Очень ужасное дело сделала дева Израиля.
ru.B: Поэтому так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q Спросите среди народов, \q кто когда-нибудь слышал о таком? \q Дева Израиль сделала страшную мерзость.
ru.R: Поэтому вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q Спросите другие народы, \q слышал ли кто-нибудь о чём-то подобном. \q Израиль должен быть как чистая девушка, \q но этот народ сделал нечто поистине ужасное.

ja.L: それゆえ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。 \q 国々の中で尋ねてみよ。 \q だれが、このようなことを聞いたことがあるか？ \q おとめイスラエルは、ひどく恐ろしいことを行った。
ja.B: それゆえ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。 \q 国々の中で尋ねてみなさい。 \q だれが、このようなことを聞いたことがあるだろうか？ \q おとめイスラエルは、実に恐ろしいことをした。
ja.R: だから、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。 \q ほかの国々に尋ねてみなさい。 \q このようなことを聞いたことがある者がいるかどうか。 \q イスラエルは、清いおとめのようであるべきなのに、 \q 本当に恐ろしいことをした。

uk.L: Тому так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: \q Спитайте між народами, \q хто чув [щось] подібне до цього? \q Діва Ізраїля вчинила дуже жахливе.
uk.B: Тому так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: \q Спитайте між народами, \q хто будь-коли чув про таке? \q Діва Ізраїль учинила найжахливіше.
uk.R: Тож ось що каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: \q Спитайте інші народи, \q чи чув хтось будь-коли про щось подібне. \q Ізраїль мав би бути, як чиста молода дівчина, \q але вона вчинила щось справді жахливе.

decisions.choice: therefore: the oracle answers the people's refusal in verse 12
decisions.reason: After the prose lesson of verses 1-12, the LORD speaks in poetry (verses 13-17) about the people who said they would follow their own plans. As elsewhere in the prophets, his words in poetry are not set in quotation marks.

decisions.choice: the virgin of Israel: the nation pictured as a young unmarried woman
decisions.reason: The picture speaks of what Israel was meant to be: young, cherished and faithful to one husband, the LORD (2:2, 32). The shock is that she has acted in a way that no other nation has (2:10-11). The same title returns in hope in 31:4 and 31:21.

decisions.choice: a horrible thing: something shocking and revolting
decisions.reason: The word is used of what makes people shudder (5:30; 23:14; Hosea 6:10). The nations are called as witnesses, because even they would not do such a thing (2:10-11).

decisions.choice: Israel should be like a pure young woman, but
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the picture of meaning decision m2, which young readers would miss in the bare title "virgin of Israel".

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD: / The LORD says this: / This is what the LORD says:
decisions.reason: The fixed wording for this formula, as in Isaiah. Balanced and Readable say "So" or "Therefore" for the word that ties it to verse 12.

decisions.choice: la virgen de Israel (Literal); la virgen Israel (Balanced); como una joven pura (Readable)
decisions.reason: The nation pictured as a young unmarried woman (meaning decision m2). Readable spells out the picture, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: no quotation marks for the oracle
decisions.reason: As in the English, the LORD's poetry spoken through the prophet takes no quotation marks; speech quoted inside an oracle does.

decisions.choice: Bikira wa Israeli (Literal); Bikira Israeli (Balanced)
decisions.reason: "Bikira" keeps the picture of the young unmarried woman; Readable spells it out as "msichana safi", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: no quotation marks for the oracle
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for the prophets: the LORD's speech in the oracles takes no quotation marks, as the English does; speech quoted inside it takes « ».

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán thế này:" / "CHÚA phán như vầy:" / "Đây là lời CHÚA phán:"; no quotation marks for the oracle
decisions.reason: The fixed forms of the terms note for "thus says the LORD", followed by a colon. The poetry of verses 13-17 is God's own speech and, as in the English, takes no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L); "이렇게 말씀하신다" (B); "하시는 말씀이다" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's formula when the prophet introduces God's words, ending in a period as published (2 Kings 19:6). The oracle that follows takes no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: "처녀 이스라엘"
decisions.reason: *betulah* is "처녀", as the terms note keeps it for 2 Kings 19:21; Readable spells out the picture as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "የእስራኤል ድንግል" (L); "ድንግሊቱ እስራኤል" (B)
decisions.reason: The nation pictured as a young woman, as the terms list treats "the daughter of Zion": Literal keeps the Hebrew construct.

decisions.choice: इस्राएल की कुँवारी (L); कुँवारी इस्राएल (B); पवित्र कुँवारी लड़की जैसा (R)
decisions.reason: The nation pictured as a young unmarried woman (meaning m2). Readable spells the picture out, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: дева Израиля (L); Дева Израиль (B)
decisions.reason: The nation is pictured as a young unmarried woman; Literal keeps the Hebrew genitive, Balanced the title as the English does; Readable spells out the picture.

decisions.choice: betulat Yisra'el "おとめイスラエル" (L, B), R as the English R ("清いおとめのようであるべきなのに"), never 彼女; sha'arurit "ひどく恐ろしいこと" (L), "実に恐ろしいこと" (B), "本当に恐ろしいこと" (R) (m3); she'alu-na' "尋ねてみよ" (L), "尋ねてみなさい" (B, R).
decisions.reason: The oracle command forms; the city or nation as a woman never 彼女.

source.text: הֲיַעֲזֹ֥ב מִצּ֛וּר שָׂדַ֖י שֶׁ֣לֶג לְבָנ֑וֹן אִם־יִנָּתְשׁ֗וּ מַ֛יִם זָרִ֥ים קָרִ֖ים נוֹזְלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Does leave from [the] rock of [the] field [the] snow of Lebanon? Or are plucked up waters strange, cold, flowing?

en.L: Does the snow of Lebanon leave the rock of the open country? \q Or are the strange, cold, flowing waters plucked up?
en.B: Does the snow of Lebanon ever vanish from its rocky heights? \q Are the cold streams that flow from far away ever cut off?
en.R: Does the snow ever disappear from the rocky peaks of Lebanon? \q Do the cold streams that flow from far away ever stop?

es.L: ¿Abandona la nieve del Líbano la roca del campo? \q ¿O se agotan las aguas extrañas, frías, que corren?
es.B: ¿Desaparece alguna vez la nieve del Líbano de sus alturas rocosas? \q ¿Se cortan alguna vez las corrientes frías que vienen de lejos?
es.R: ¿Desaparece alguna vez la nieve de las cumbres rocosas del Líbano? \q ¿Dejan alguna vez de correr los arroyos fríos que vienen de lejos?

fr.L: La neige du Liban quitte-t-elle le rocher de la campagne ? \q Ou bien les eaux étrangères, fraîches, ruisselantes, sont-elles arrachées ?
fr.B: La neige du Liban disparaît-elle jamais de ses hauteurs rocheuses ? \q Les eaux fraîches qui coulent de loin tarissent-elles jamais ?
fr.R: Est-ce que la neige disparaît un jour des sommets rocheux du Liban ? \q Est-ce que les ruisseaux d’eau fraîche qui viennent de loin s’arrêtent un jour de couler ?

sw.L: Je, theluji ya Lebanoni huondoka kwenye mwamba wa porini? \q Au maji mageni, baridi, yatiririkayo hung'olewa?
sw.B: Je, theluji ya Lebanoni huwahi kutoweka kutoka vilele vyake vya miamba? \q Je, vijito vya baridi vitiririkavyo kutoka mbali huwahi kukatika?
sw.R: Je, theluji huwahi kutoweka kwenye vilele vya miamba vya Lebanoni? \q Je, vijito vya maji baridi vinavyotiririka kutoka mbali huwahi kuacha kutiririka?

vi.L: Tuyết của Li-ban có rời khỏi tảng đá của đồng ruộng chăng? \q Hay những dòng nước xa lạ, lạnh lẽo, đang chảy có bị nhổ đi chăng?
vi.B: Tuyết trên Li-ban có bao giờ tan biến khỏi các đỉnh núi đá chăng? \q Những dòng suối mát lạnh chảy từ xa có bao giờ bị cắt đứt chăng?
vi.R: Tuyết trên các đỉnh núi đá của Li-ban có bao giờ biến mất không? \q Những dòng suối lạnh chảy từ xa có bao giờ ngừng chảy không?

ko.L: 레바논의 눈이 들판의 바위에서 떠나겠느냐? \q 낯선 곳에서 흘러오는 차가운 물이 뽑히겠느냐?
ko.B: 레바논의 눈이 그 바위 산꼭대기에서 사라진 적이 있느냐? \q 먼 곳에서 흘러오는 차가운 시냇물이 끊긴 적이 있느냐?
ko.R: 레바논의 바위 산봉우리에서 눈이 사라진 적이 있느냐? \q 먼 곳에서 흘러오는 차가운 시냇물이 멈춘 적이 있느냐?

pt.L: Acaso a neve do Líbano deixa a rocha do campo? \q Ou são arrancadas as águas estranhas, frias, correntes?
pt.B: Acaso a neve do Líbano desaparece alguma vez dos seus altos rochedos? \q Acaso secam um dia as águas frias que correm de longe?
pt.R: Será que a neve some algum dia dos picos rochosos do Líbano? \q Será que os riachos frios que vêm de longe param de correr?

am.L: የሊባኖስ በረዶ ከሜዳው ዓለት ይለያልን? \q ወይስ የሩቅ አገር ቀዝቃዛ ፈሳሽ ውኃዎች ይነቀላሉን?
am.B: የሊባኖስ በረዶ ከዓለታማ ከፍታዎቹ ከቶ ይጠፋልን? \q ከሩቅ የሚፈሱ ቀዝቃዛ ጅረቶችስ ከቶ ይቋረጣሉን?
am.R: በሊባኖስ ዓለታማ ተራሮች ላይ ያለው በረዶ ከቶ ይጠፋልን? \q ከሩቅ የሚፈሱ ቀዝቃዛ ጅረቶችስ ከቶ ይቆማሉን?

hi.L: क्या लबानोन का हिम मैदान की चट्टान को छोड़ देता है? \q या क्या पराए, ठंडे, बहते जल उखाड़े जाते हैं?
hi.B: क्या लबानोन का हिम कभी उसकी चट्टानी ऊँचाइयों से मिटता है? \q क्या दूर से बहकर आनेवाली ठंडी धाराएँ कभी सूखती हैं?
hi.R: क्या लबानोन की चट्टानी चोटियों से बर्फ़ कभी मिटती है? \q क्या दूर से बहकर आनेवाली ठंडी धाराएँ कभी रुकती हैं?

ru.L: Разве покидает скалу поля снег Ливана? \q Или иссякают чужие, холодные, текущие воды?
ru.B: Разве исчезает когда-нибудь снег Ливана с его скалистых вершин? \q Разве пересыхают когда-нибудь холодные потоки, текущие издалека?
ru.R: Разве исчезает когда-нибудь снег на скалистых вершинах Ливана? \q Разве перестают течь холодные ручьи, которые бегут издалека?

ja.L: レバノンの雪は、野の岩から消えるだろうか？ \q よそから来る冷たい流れの水が、引き抜かれるだろうか？
ja.B: レバノンの雪が、その岩山から消えることがあるだろうか？ \q 遠くから流れて来る冷たい流れが、絶えることがあるだろうか？
ja.R: レバノンの岩山の頂から、雪が消えることがあるだろうか？ \q 遠くから流れて来る冷たい川が、止まることがあるだろうか？

uk.L: Чи сходить сніг Ливану зі скелі поля? \q Чи висихають чужі, холодні, текучі води?
uk.B: Чи зникає будь-коли сніг Ливану з його скелястих вершин? \q Чи пересихають колись холодні потоки, що течуть здалека?
uk.R: Чи зникає будь-коли сніг зі скелястих вершин Ливану? \q Чи зупиняються колись холодні потоки, що течуть здалека?

decisions.choice: two questions that expect the answer "no"
decisions.reason: The snow on the high mountains of Lebanon lasts all year, and the streams fed by it keep flowing. Nature stays true to its course; the next verse sets Israel's unfaithfulness against it. This is the plain sense, though the details of the verse are hard to read.

decisions.choice: the rock of the field: the rocky slopes or heights of the open country
alternatives: from the rock of the Almighty
decisions.reason: The words are "the rock of the field", which may mean the rocky high ground of Lebanon itself. With a small change of letters some read a name, such as Sirion (Mount Hermon, Deuteronomy 3:9), or "the rock of the Almighty". The meaning of the whole verse stays much the same.

decisions.choice: are the strange, cold, flowing waters plucked up: do the cold streams from far away ever fail
decisions.reason: The verb means to be pulled up or torn away, an odd word for water; with two letters exchanged it would mean "dry up". "Strange" usually means foreign; here it may mean waters that come from far off, or, with one letter changed, "from the mountains". The point is that these streams never stop.

decisions.choice: ever cut off / ever stop; that flow from far away
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of meaning decision m3 in plain words and add "ever" to show that the questions expect "no" (m1).

decisions.choice: लबानोन
decisions.reason: The form of the name in the earlier books of this translation (Psalms, Isaiah).

decisions.choice: mitstsur sadai "野の岩から" (L), "岩山から" (B, R) (m2, uncertain); yinnateshu "引き抜かれる" (L, the literal verb), "絶える" (B), "止まる" (R) (m3, uncertain); zarim "よそから来る" (L), "遠くから流れて来る" (B, R).
decisions.reason: A hard verse; Japanese follows the English reading at each level.

source.text: כִּֽי־שְׁכֵחֻ֥נִי עַמִּ֖י לַשָּׁ֣וְא יְקַטֵּ֑רוּ וַיַּכְשִׁל֤וּם בְּדַרְכֵיהֶם֙ שְׁבִילֵ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם לָלֶ֣כֶת נְתִיב֔וֹת דֶּ֖רֶךְ לֹ֥א סְלוּלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For have forgotten me my people; to worthlessness they burn incense, and they have made them stumble in their ways, [the] paths of antiquity, to walk [in] bypaths, a road not built up,

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people have forgotten {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; they burn incense to worthlessness, \q and they have made them stumble in their ways, the ancient roads, \q to walk on bypaths, a road not built up,
en.B: Yet {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people have forgotten {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; they make offerings of incense to worthless gods, \q which have made them stumble in their ways, on the ancient roads, \q so that they walk on side paths, on a road that is not built up,
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people have forgotten {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. They burn incense to useless idols. \q These idols have made them stumble on the old, well-known roads. \q Now they walk on side paths, on rough roads that no one has built.

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha olvidado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo; queman incienso a la vanidad, \q y los han hecho tropezar en sus caminos, las sendas antiguas, \q para andar por veredas, un camino no allanado,
es.B: Sin embargo, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha olvidado; ofrecen incienso a dioses vanos, \q que los han hecho tropezar en sus caminos, en las sendas antiguas, \q para que anden por senderos, por un camino sin allanar,
es.R: Pero {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha olvidado. Queman incienso a ídolos inútiles. \q Esos ídolos los han hecho tropezar en los caminos antiguos y conocidos. \q Ahora andan por senderos, por caminos ásperos que nadie ha preparado.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a oublié ; ils brûlent de l’encens au néant, \q et ils les ont fait trébucher dans leurs voies, les sentiers d’autrefois, \q pour marcher dans des chemins de traverse, une route non tracée,
fr.B: Pourtant {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a oublié ; ils offrent de l’encens à des dieux de néant, \q qui les ont fait trébucher dans leurs voies, sur les sentiers anciens, \q pour qu’ils marchent sur des chemins détournés, sur une route non aménagée,
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a oublié. Ils brûlent de l’encens pour des idoles qui ne servent à rien. \q Ces idoles les ont fait trébucher sur les bonnes routes d’autrefois. \q Maintenant, ils marchent sur des petits chemins, sur des routes mal tracées que personne n’a construites.

sw.L: Lakini watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wamenisahau; wanafukiza uvumba kwa ubatili, \q nao wamewakwaza katika njia zao, njia za zamani, \q ili watembee katika vijia, njia isiyotengenezwa,
sw.B: Hata hivyo watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wamenisahau; wanafukiza uvumba kwa miungu isiyofaa kitu, \q ambayo imewakwaza katika njia zao, katika njia za zamani, \q hata wanatembea katika vijia vya pembeni, katika njia isiyotengenezwa,
sw.R: Lakini watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wamenisahau. Wanafukiza uvumba kwa sanamu zisizo na faida. \q Sanamu hizo zimewakwaza katika njia za zamani zinazojulikana. \q Sasa wanatembea katika vijia vya pembeni, katika njia mbovu ambazo hakuna aliyezitengeneza.

vi.L: Nhưng dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã quên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; chúng đốt hương cho sự hư không, \q và chúng đã làm cho dân vấp ngã trên đường lối mình, là các nẻo đường xưa, \q để đi trên các lối tắt, một con đường không được đắp,
vi.B: Thế mà dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã quên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; chúng dâng hương cho các thần hư không, \q là những thần đã làm cho chúng vấp ngã trên đường lối mình, trên các nẻo đường xưa, \q khiến chúng đi theo những lối mòn, trên con đường chưa được đắp,
vi.R: Nhưng dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã quên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Chúng đốt hương cho các thần tượng vô dụng. \q Các thần tượng ấy đã làm cho chúng vấp ngã trên những con đường xưa quen thuộc. \q Giờ đây chúng đi theo những lối mòn, trên những con đường gồ ghề không ai đắp.

ko.L: 그러나 내 백성은 나를 잊었고, 헛된 것에게 분향한다. \q 그것들이 그들을 그들의 길, 옛길에서 넘어지게 하여 \q 샛길, 닦지 않은 길로 걷게 했다.
ko.B: 그런데 내 백성은 나를 잊어버리고 헛된 신들에게 분향한다. \q 그 신들이 내 백성을 그들의 길, 옛길에서 넘어지게 하여 \q 샛길로, 닦지 않은 길로 걷게 했다.
ko.R: 그러나 내 백성은 나를 잊었다. 그들은 쓸모없는 우상들에게 향을 피운다. \q 그 우상들 때문에 그들은 오래전부터 잘 알던 길에서 넘어졌다. \q 이제 그들은 샛길로, 아무도 닦지 않은 험한 길로 다닌다.

pt.L: Mas o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} esqueceu; faz subir fumaça à inutilidade, \q e eles os fizeram tropeçar nos seus caminhos, as veredas antigas, \q para andarem por atalhos, por um caminho não aplanado,
pt.B: Mas o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} esqueceu; queima ofertas a deuses inúteis, \q que o fizeram tropeçar nos seus caminhos, nas veredas antigas, \q para que andasse por atalhos, por uma estrada que não foi aplanada,
pt.R: Mas o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} esqueceu. Eles queimam ofertas a ídolos inúteis. \q Esses ídolos os fizeram tropeçar nos caminhos antigos e conhecidos. \q Agora andam por atalhos, por estradas ruins que ninguém construiu.

am.L: ሕዝቤ ግን ረስቶኛል፤ ለከንቱነት ያጥናሉ፤ \q በመንገዳቸውም፣ በጥንቱ ጎዳና አሰናከሏቸው፤ \q ባልተሠራ መንገድ፣ በጠባብ መንገዶች ይሄዱ ዘንድ፤
am.B: ሕዝቤ ግን ረስቶኛል፤ ለከንቱ አማልክት ዕጣን ያጥናሉ፤ \q እነዚህም በመንገዳቸው፣ በጥንቱ ጎዳና ላይ አሰናከሏቸው፤ \q ስለዚህ ባልተሠራ መንገድ፣ በጎዳና ዳር ባሉ መንገዶች ይሄዳሉ፤
am.R: ሕዝቤ ግን ረስቶኛል። ለማይጠቅሙ ጣዖታት ዕጣን ያጥናሉ። \q እነዚህ ጣዖታት በተለመዱት የጥንት መንገዶች ላይ አሰናከሏቸው። \q አሁን ማንም ባልሠራቸው ሻካራ መንገዶች፣ በጎዳና ዳር ባሉ መንገዶች ይሄዳሉ።

hi.L: पर मेरी प्रजा मुझे भूल गई है; वे व्यर्थ [वस्तु] के लिए धूप जलाते हैं, \q और उन्होंने उन्हें उनके मार्गों में, पुराने रास्तों में ठोकर खिलाई है, \q कि वे पगडंडियों पर चलें, ऐसे रास्ते पर जो बनाया नहीं गया,
hi.B: फिर भी मेरी प्रजा मुझे भूल गई है; वे निकम्मे देवताओं के आगे धूप जलाते हैं, \q जिन्होंने उन्हें उनके मार्गों में, पुराने रास्तों पर ठोकर खिलाई है, \q कि वे पगडंडियों पर चलें, ऐसे रास्ते पर जो बनाया नहीं गया,
hi.R: पर मेरे लोग मुझे भूल गए हैं। वे बेकार मूर्तियों के आगे धूप जलाते हैं। \q इन मूर्तियों ने उन्हें पुराने, जाने-पहचाने रास्तों पर ठोकर खिलाई है। \q अब वे पगडंडियों पर, ऊबड़-खाबड़ रास्तों पर चलते हैं जिन्हें किसी ने नहीं बनाया।

ru.L: А {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ забыл {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}; пустоте они воскуряют, \q и они заставили их споткнуться на их путях, древних дорогах, \q чтобы ходить по тропам, по дороге не насыпанной,
ru.B: А {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ забыл {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}; они сжигают благовония никчёмным богам, \q которые заставили их споткнуться на их путях, на древних дорогах, \q так что они ходят окольными тропами, по дороге, которую никто не проложил,
ru.R: Но {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ забыл {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. Они сжигают благовония бесполезным идолам. \q Эти идолы заставили их споткнуться на старых, хорошо знакомых дорогах. \q Теперь они ходят по боковым тропам, по неровным дорогам, которые никто не строил.

ja.L: しかし、わたしの民はわたしを忘れ、空しいものに香をたいている。 \q それらは彼らを、その道で、昔からの道でつまずかせ、 \q 小道を、築かれていない道を歩ませる。
ja.B: しかし、わたしの民はわたしを忘れ、空しい神々に香をたいている。 \q その神々が、彼らをその道で、昔からの道でつまずかせ、 \q わき道を、築かれていない道を歩ませる。
ja.R: ところが、わたしの民はわたしを忘れてしまった。彼らは、役に立たない偶像に香をたいている。 \q その偶像が、昔からよく知られた道で、彼らをつまずかせた。 \q 今、彼らはわき道を、だれも造ったことのないでこぼこの道を歩いている。

uk.L: А {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ забув {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}; вони кадять марноті, \q і вони спотикнули їх на їхніх дорогах, давніх шляхах, \q щоб ходити стежками, дорогою не насипаною,
uk.B: А {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ забув {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}; вони кадять нікчемним богам, \q що спотикнули їх на їхніх дорогах, на давніх шляхах, \q так що вони ходять бічними стежками, дорогою, яку ніхто не насипав,
uk.R: Але {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ забув {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}. Вони палять ладан нікчемним ідолам. \q Ці ідоли змусили їх спіткнутися на давніх, знайомих дорогах. \q Тепер вони ходять бічними стежками, вибоїстими дорогами, яких ніхто не прокладав.

decisions.choice: worthlessness: emptiness, the false gods that are nothing
decisions.reason: The word means what is empty, false or useless. Here it stands for the idols, which have nothing in them to help (2:5; 10:15; 16:19).

decisions.choice: they have made them stumble: the worthless gods have tripped up the people
alternatives: those who led them astray have made them stumble
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. It most naturally refers to the worthless gods just named; it may also mean those who led the people to them, such as false prophets (23:13). Either way the people have been led off the right road.

decisions.choice: the ancient roads: the old, good way of faithfulness to the LORD
decisions.reason: God had told the people to ask for "the paths of long ago" and walk in the good way (6:16). They have left those tried roads for rough tracks of their own.

decisions.choice: a road not built up: a rough track, not a proper highway
decisions.reason: A main road was built up with earth and stones so that it was raised, level and clear (Isaiah 57:14; 62:10). A road "not built up" is uneven and easy to stumble on. The sentence runs on into verse 16.

decisions.choice: worthless gods, which ... / useless idols. These idols ...
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that the worthless things are false gods and make them the subject of "made them stumble", following meaning decisions m1 and m2.

decisions.choice: dioses vanos, que ... / ídolos inútiles. Esos ídolos ...
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "worthlessness" names the false gods (meaning decision m1). Balanced and Readable say so, and make the gods the subject of "hacer tropezar", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "au néant" (L); "des dieux de néant" (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means emptiness; Literal keeps the abstract noun, Balanced names the false gods it stands for, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "làm cho dân vấp ngã" (Literal)
decisions.reason: Literal says "dân" for the object so that the reader does not take "chúng" as the same people who burn incense: it is the worthless gods that trip the people up (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: lashshav' "空しいもの" (L), "空しい神々" (B), "役に立たない偶像" (R) (m1); the idols are "それら" / "その神々" / "その偶像", never 彼ら (m2, uncertain); yeqatteru "香をたく" (every level); shevilei 'olam "昔からの道" (m3).
decisions.reason: JER-2: idols それ / それら, never 彼ら; qitter as the JER table.

source.text: לָשׂ֥וּם אַרְצָ֛ם לְשַׁמָּ֖ה שְׁרִיק֣וֹתעוֹלָ֑ם כֹּ֚ל עוֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ יִשֹּׁ֖ם וְיָנִ֥יד בְּרֹאשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: to make their land a horror, hissings forever; every one passing by it will be appalled and will shake with his head.

en.L: to make their land a horror, a hissing forever; \q everyone who passes by it will be appalled and shake {{gender:their|his}} head.
en.B: making their land a horror, an object of scorn forever; \q all who pass by it will be appalled and shake their heads.
en.R: So their land will become a horror, something people mock forever. \q Everyone who passes by will be shocked and will shake their heads.

es.L: para hacer de su tierra un horror, una burla para siempre; \q todo el que pase por ella se asombrará y meneará la cabeza.
es.B: convirtiendo su tierra en un horror, en objeto de burla para siempre; \q todos los que pasen por ella se espantarán y menearán la cabeza.
es.R: Así su tierra se convertirá en un horror, en algo de lo que la gente se burlará para siempre. \q Todos los que pasen por allí se quedarán espantados y menearán la cabeza.

fr.L: pour faire de leur pays une horreur, un objet de sifflements pour toujours ; \q quiconque passera près de lui sera stupéfait et hochera la tête.
fr.B: faisant de leur pays un objet d’horreur et de moquerie pour toujours ; \q tous ceux qui y passeront seront consternés et hocheront la tête.
fr.R: Leur pays va devenir une horreur, quelque chose dont les gens se moqueront pour toujours. \q Tous ceux qui passeront par là seront choqués et hocheront la tête.

sw.L: kuifanya nchi yao kuwa kitisho, [kitu cha] kuzomewa milele; \q kila apitaye karibu nayo atashangaa na kutikisa kichwa chake.
sw.B: wakiifanya nchi yao kuwa kitisho, kitu cha kudharauliwa milele; \q wote wapitao karibu nayo watashangaa na kutikisa vichwa vyao.
sw.R: Hivyo nchi yao itakuwa kitisho, kitu ambacho watu hukidhihaki milele. \q Kila mtu atakayepita karibu nayo atashtuka na kutikisa kichwa.

vi.L: để làm cho xứ chúng thành một điều kinh hoàng, một tiếng huýt sáo đời đời; \q mọi người đi ngang qua nó sẽ kinh hãi và lắc đầu.
vi.B: khiến xứ chúng thành một điều kinh hoàng, một mối nhạo báng đời đời; \q mọi người đi ngang qua đều kinh hãi và lắc đầu.
vi.R: Vì thế xứ chúng sẽ thành một nơi đáng sợ, một chỗ người ta chế giễu mãi mãi. \q Ai đi ngang qua cũng sẽ sửng sốt và lắc đầu.

ko.L: 그들의 땅을 공포와 영원한 휘파람거리로 만들 것이다. \q 그 곁을 지나가는 사람마다 놀라 그의 머리를 흔들 것이다.
ko.B: 그래서 그들의 땅은 공포의 대상, 영원히 비웃음거리가 될 것이다. \q 그곳을 지나가는 사람은 모두 놀라서 머리를 흔들 것이다.
ko.R: 그래서 그들의 땅은 끔찍한 곳, 사람들이 영원히 비웃는 곳이 될 것이다. \q 그곳을 지나가는 사람은 모두 깜짝 놀라 머리를 흔들 것이다.

pt.L: para fazer da sua terra um horror, um assobio para sempre; \q todo aquele que passar por ela ficará espantado e balançará a cabeça.
pt.B: fazendo da sua terra um horror, objeto de zombaria para sempre; \q todos os que passarem por ela ficarão espantados e balançarão a cabeça.
pt.R: Por isso a sua terra vai se tornar um horror, algo de que as pessoas vão zombar para sempre. \q Todos os que passarem por ali vão ficar chocados e balançar a cabeça.

am.L: ምድራቸውን ማስደንገጫ፣ ለዘላለምም ማፏጫ ያደርጉ ዘንድ፤ \q በእርሷ የሚያልፍ ሁሉ ይደነግጣል፤ ራሱንም ይነቀንቃል።
am.B: ምድራቸውን ማስደንገጫ፣ ለዘላለምም መሳለቂያ አደረጉ፤ \q በእርሷ የሚያልፉ ሁሉ ይደነግጣሉ፤ ራሳቸውንም ይነቀንቃሉ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ምድራቸው አስደንጋጭ ትሆናለች፤ ሰዎችም ለዘላለም ይሳለቁባታል። \q በአጠገቧ የሚያልፍ ሁሉ ይደነግጣል፤ ራሱንም ይነቀንቃል።

hi.L: कि उनके देश को भय का कारण, सदा के लिए सीटी का विषय बनाएँ; \q हर एक जो उसके पास से गुज़रेगा, चकित होगा और अपना सिर हिलाएगा।
hi.B: इस प्रकार उनका देश भय का कारण और सदा के लिए उपहास का विषय बन जाएगा; \q उसके पास से गुज़रनेवाले सब चकित होंगे और सिर हिलाएँगे।
hi.R: इसलिए उनका देश ऐसा भयानक बन जाएगा कि लोग सदा उसका मज़ाक़ उड़ाएँगे। \q जो कोई उसके पास से गुज़रेगा, वह चौंक जाएगा और सिर हिलाएगा।

ru.L: чтобы сделать их землю ужасом, вечным посмеянием; \q всякий, проходящий через неё, ужаснётся и покачает своей головой.
ru.B: и делает их землю ужасом, вечным предметом насмешек; \q каждый, кто проходит через неё, ужаснётся и покачает головой.
ru.R: Поэтому их земля станет ужасом, тем, над чем люди будут вечно смеяться. \q Каждый, кто будет проходить мимо, придёт в ужас и покачает головой.

ja.L: それは、彼らの地を恐怖とし、とこしえのあざけりの口笛とするためだ。 \q そこを通り過ぎる者はみな驚き、その頭を振る。
ja.B: こうして、彼らの地は、恐怖ととこしえのあざけりの的となる。 \q そこを通り過ぎる者はみな驚き、頭を振る。
ja.R: こうして、彼らの土地は恐ろしい所となり、いつまでも人々にあざけられる。 \q そこを通り過ぎる人はみな、驚いて頭を振る。

uk.L: щоб зробити свою землю жахом, посвистом навіки; \q кожен, хто проходить нею, остовпіє і похитає головою.
uk.B: і роблять свою землю жахом, предметом зневаги навіки; \q усі, хто проходить нею, жахаються і хитають головою.
uk.R: Тож їхня земля стане жахом, з якого люди глузуватимуть навіки. \q Кожен, хто проходитиме мимо, буде вражений і хитатиме головою.

decisions.choice: to make: the result of their wandering, the end to which it leads
decisions.reason: The form often expresses purpose, but here it gives the outcome: by leaving the good road the people bring ruin on their own land. It is not that they meant to.

decisions.choice: a hissing: a whistle of shock and scorn at a ruin
decisions.reason: People who passed a destroyed place whistled or hissed in amazement and contempt (19:8; 1 Kings 9:8; Lamentations 2:15). The written text and the text as read differ by one letter in this word; both mean "hissing".

decisions.choice: shake the head: a gesture of horror and mockery
decisions.reason: Shaking the head over someone's fall expresses both dismay and scorn (Psalm 22:8; Lamentations 2:15).

decisions.choice: horror, hissing / horror, object of scorn / horror, something people mock
decisions.reason: The wording settled for this pair in Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: their head, with "his head" as the gender alternative
decisions.reason: "Everyone who passes by" means men and women alike, so Literal's "his" becomes "their" by default. Balanced and Readable say "all ... their heads", which needs no alternative.

decisions.choice: un horror, una burla (Literal); un horror, objeto de burla (Balanced); un horror, algo de lo que la gente se burlará (Readable)
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's lists of horror and hissing keep one Spanish wording through the block. The hissing (*shereqah*) is a whistle of scorn at a ruin; Spanish has no matching gesture, so even Literal says "burla", with the gesture explained in meaning decision m2.

decisions.choice: kitisho, [kitu cha] kuzomewa / kitisho, kitu cha kudharauliwa / kitisho, kitu ambacho watu hukidhihaki
decisions.reason: The wording used for this list throughout Jeremiah: Literal keeps the hissing ("kuzomewa", jeered at), Balanced and Readable say what it expresses; the verb *sharaq* is "kuzomea" (L), "kuzomea kwa dharau" (B), "kudhihaki" (R). "Kila apitaye ... kichwa chake" needs no gender alternative in Swahili.

decisions.choice: "une horreur, un objet de sifflements" (L); "un objet d'horreur et de moquerie" (B); "une horreur, quelque chose dont les gens se moqueront" (R)
alternatives: un sujet d'étonnement et de risée
decisions.reason: The French wording settled for this pair in Jeremiah 18-34. "Quiconque ... il" is generic French, so no gender setting is needed where the English Literal has one.

decisions.choice: "điều kinh hoàng, tiếng huýt sáo" / "điều kinh hoàng, mối nhạo báng" / "nơi đáng sợ, chỗ người ta chế giễu"
decisions.reason: One set of words for Jeremiah's lists of "horror" and "hissing" (shereqah), used each time they return in these chapters (19:8; 25:9, 18; 29:18). Literal keeps the whistle of scorn; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: "공포 ... 휘파람거리" (L); "공포의 대상 ... 비웃음거리" (B); "끔찍한 곳 ... 사람들이 비웃는 곳" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording per level for Jeremiah's lists of horror, hissing and curse, as the English. Literal keeps the hissing whistle (meaning decision m2); Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: um horror, um assobio (L); um horror, objeto de zombaria (B); um horror, algo de que as pessoas vão zombar (R); balançar a cabeça
alternatives: um horror e um escárnio (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (19:8; 25:9, 18; 29:18; 49:17; 50:13; 51:37), as the English keeps one wording for the pair (r-en-1): Literal keeps the picture of the whistle of shock and scorn (m2) with "assobio", Balanced and Readable say what it means. "Todo aquele que" already means anyone, so the English "their/his" has no Portuguese span.

decisions.choice: "жах, посвист" (L), "жах, предмет зневаги" (B), "жах, з якого люди глузують" (R) in the horror lists, through the book
decisions.reason: Follows the terms note's three levels: the Literal keeps the whistle of the Hebrew, the others its sense.

decisions.choice: भय का कारण, सीटी का विषय (L); भय का कारण, उपहास का विषय (B); भयानक, लोग मज़ाक़ उड़ाएँगे (R)
decisions.reason: The pair "a horror and a hissing" follows the Jeremiah terms list: the hiss of scorn at a ruin (meaning m2) at Literal, "scorn" at Balanced, "something people mock" at Readable. One wording per level through the book (19:8; 25:9, 18; 29:18; 51:37), with सीटी का विषय as 2 Chronicles 29:8.

decisions.choice: ужас, посмеяние (L); ужас, предмет насмешек (B); ужас, то, над чем люди смеются (R)
decisions.reason: The pair "a horror, a hissing" in one wording per level through the book (19:8; 25:9, 18; 29:18; 51:37). The noun takes Literal's "посмеяние" from 2 Chronicles 29:8 in this translation; the verb "hiss" keeps the whistle of scorn, "свистеть", as 1 Kings 9:8 does with "засвистит".

decisions.choice: "своей головой" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: Russian "всякий" and the reflexive "свой" already include men and women, so no gender span is needed where the English Literal has one.

decisions.choice: shammah "恐怖" (L, B), "恐ろしい所" (R); sheriqot "あざけりの口笛" (L), "あざけりの的" (B), "あざけられる" (R) (m2), as 2CH 29:8; yanid bero'sho "頭を振る", no gender span (r-en-2).
decisions.reason: 2CH-2 (za'avah / shammah / sheriqah); these forms should serve 19:8, 25:9, 29:18.

source.text: כְּרֽוּחַ־קָדִ֥ים אֲפִיצֵ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב עֹ֧רֶף וְלֹֽא־פָנִ֛ים אֶרְאֵ֖ם בְּי֥וֹם אֵידָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Like a wind of [the] east I will scatter them before [the] enemy; [the] back and not [the] face I will show them in [the] day of their calamity.

en.L: Like the east wind I will scatter them before the enemy; \q I will show them [the] back and not [the] face in the day of their calamity.
en.B: Like the east wind I will scatter them before the enemy; \q I will show them {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} back, not {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face, on the day of their disaster.
en.R: I will scatter them in front of their enemies, as the east wind scatters dust. \q On the day disaster strikes them, I will turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} back on them. I will not turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face toward them.

es.L: Como el viento del oriente los esparciré delante del enemigo; \q [la] espalda y no [el] rostro les mostraré en el día de su calamidad.
es.B: Como el viento del este los dispersaré delante del enemigo; \q les mostraré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} espalda y no {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro el día de su desgracia.
es.R: Los dispersaré delante de sus enemigos, como el viento del este dispersa el polvo. \q El día en que les llegue el desastre, les daré la espalda. \q No volveré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro hacia ellos.

fr.L: Comme le vent d’orient, je les disperserai devant l’ennemi ; \q je leur montrerai [le] dos et non [la] face au jour de leur désastre.
fr.B: Comme le vent d’est, je les disperserai devant l’ennemi ; \q je leur montrerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} dos et non {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} visage au jour de leur malheur.
fr.R: Je les disperserai devant leurs ennemis, comme le vent d’est disperse la poussière. \q Le jour où le malheur les frappera, je leur tournerai le dos. \q Je ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tournerai pas vers eux.

sw.L: Kama upepo wa mashariki nitawatawanya mbele ya adui; \q nitawaonyesha kisogo wala si uso katika siku ya msiba wao.
sw.B: Kama upepo wa mashariki nitawatawanya mbele ya adui; \q nitawaonyesha mgongo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, si uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, siku ya maafa yao.
sw.R: Nitawatawanya mbele ya adui zao, kama upepo wa mashariki unavyotawanya mavumbi. \q Siku maafa yatakapowapata, nitawageuzia mgongo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Sitawaelekezea uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.

vi.L: Như gió đông, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm chúng tan lạc trước mặt kẻ thù; \q Ta sẽ cho chúng thấy lưng chứ không [thấy] mặt trong ngày tai họa của chúng.
vi.B: Như ngọn gió đông, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm chúng tan tác trước mặt kẻ thù; \q Ta sẽ quay lưng chứ không quay mặt về phía chúng trong ngày tai họa của chúng.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm chúng tan tác trước mặt kẻ thù, như gió đông thổi bụi bay đi. \q Vào ngày tai họa ập đến, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quay lưng lại với chúng. Ta sẽ không quay mặt về phía chúng.

ko.L: 동풍처럼 내가 그들을 원수 앞에서 흩을 것이다. \q 그들의 재난의 날에 내가 그들에게 [내] 등을 보이고 얼굴을 보이지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 동풍이 불어 흩어 버리듯이 내가 그들을 원수 앞에서 흩어 버리겠다. \q 그들이 재난을 당하는 날에, 나는 그들에게 얼굴을 보이지 않고 등을 보이겠다.
ko.R: 동풍이 먼지를 흩날리듯이 내가 그들을 원수들 앞에서 흩어 버리겠다. \q 재난이 그들에게 닥치는 날에 나는 그들에게서 등을 돌리겠다. 그들을 향하여 얼굴을 돌리지 않겠다.

pt.L: Como o vento oriental eu os espalharei diante do inimigo; \q [as] costas e não [o] rosto lhes mostrarei no dia da sua calamidade.
pt.B: Como o vento oriental, eu os espalharei diante do inimigo; \q no dia da sua desgraça eu lhes mostrarei as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} costas, e não o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rosto.
pt.R: Vou espalhá-los diante dos seus inimigos, como o vento do leste espalha a poeira. \q No dia em que a desgraça cair sobre eles, vou virar as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} costas para eles. Não vou voltar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rosto para eles.

am.L: እንደ ምሥራቅ ነፋስ በጠላት ፊት እበትናቸዋለሁ፤ \q በመከራቸውም ቀን ጀርባ እንጂ ፊት አላሳያቸውም።
am.B: እንደ ምሥራቅ ነፋስ በጠላት ፊት እበትናቸዋለሁ፤ \q በጥፋታቸውም ቀን ጀርባዬን እንጂ ፊቴን አላሳያቸውም።
am.R: የምሥራቅ ነፋስ አቧራን እንደሚበትን በጠላቶቻቸው ፊት እበትናቸዋለሁ። \q ጥፋት በሚደርስባቸው ቀን ጀርባዬን እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ ፊቴንም ወደ እነርሱ አላዞርም።

hi.L: पूर्वी हवा के समान मैं उन्हें शत्रु के सामने तितर-बितर कर दूँगा; \q उनकी विपत्ति के दिन मैं उन्हें [अपनी] पीठ दिखाऊँगा, मुँह नहीं।
hi.B: पूर्वी हवा के समान मैं उन्हें शत्रु के सामने तितर-बितर कर दूँगा; \q उनकी विपत्ति के दिन मैं उन्हें अपनी पीठ दिखाऊँगा, अपना मुँह नहीं।
hi.R: जैसे पूर्वी हवा धूल उड़ा ले जाती है, वैसे ही मैं उन्हें उनके शत्रुओं के सामने तितर-बितर कर दूँगा। \q जिस दिन उन पर विपत्ति आएगी, मैं उनसे मुँह फेर लूँगा। मैं उनकी ओर नहीं देखूँगा।

ru.L: Как восточный ветер, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} рассею их перед врагом; \q спиной, а не лицом, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покажусь им в день их бедствия.
ru.B: Как восточный ветер, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} рассею их перед врагом; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покажу им {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} спину, а не {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} лицо, в день их бедствия.
ru.R: Я рассею их перед их врагами, как восточный ветер разносит пыль. \q В день, когда их постигнет бедствие, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} повернусь к ним спиной. Я не обращу к ним {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} лица.

ja.L: 東風のように、わたしは彼らを敵の前で散らす。 \q 彼らの災いの日に、わたしは彼らに背を見せ、顔を見せない。
ja.B: 東風のように、わたしは彼らを敵の前で吹き散らす。 \q 彼らの災いの日に、わたしは彼らに背を向け、顔を向けない。
ja.R: 東風がちりを吹き散らすように、わたしは彼らを敵の前で散らす。 \q 災いが彼らを襲う日に、わたしは彼らに背を向ける。彼らに顔を向けない。

uk.L: Як східний вітер, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} розвію їх перед ворогом; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покажу їм спину, а не обличчя, у день їхнього нещастя.
uk.B: Як східний вітер, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} розвію їх перед ворогом; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покажу їм {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} спину, а не {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} обличчя, у день їхнього лиха.
uk.R: Я розкидаю їх перед їхніми ворогами, як східний вітер розкидає порох. \q У день, коли на них упаде лихо, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} обернуся до них спиною. Я не оберну до них {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} обличчя.

decisions.choice: the east wind: the hot, dry wind off the desert
decisions.reason: The east wind blows in from the desert, withering plants and driving dust before it (4:11; 13:24). The people will be blown away before their enemy as dust and chaff are blown by it.

decisions.choice: show them the back and not the face: turn away from them and refuse help
decisions.reason: To turn the face toward someone is to look on him with favor and help him; to turn the back is to reject him. The people did this to God (2:27; 32:33), and now God will do it to them on the day they need him. With other vowels the letters could read "I will look on them with my back, not my face"; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the day of their calamity: the day disaster overtakes them
decisions.reason: The word means a crushing disaster, the ruin that falls on a people or a person (46:21; 48:16; Proverbs 1:26-27).

decisions.choice: [the] back ... [the] face
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no "the" or "my" here. Literal adds the article in brackets; Balanced says "my back, not my face", which is the meaning.

decisions.choice: as the east wind scatters dust; turn my back on them
decisions.reason: Readable says what the east wind scatters and uses the English phrase "turn my back on", which carries the same picture as the Hebrew (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "je leur tournerai le dos" (R), with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: French "tourner le dos à" carries the same picture as the Hebrew without a possessive, so Readable has no span where the English has "my back".

decisions.choice: 'oref velo'-fanim 'er'em "背を見せ、顔を見せない" (L), "背を向け、顔を向けない" (B, R) (m2); ruach qadim "東風" (every level), R adds "ちりを" as the English R.
decisions.reason: As the English levels; the brackets of the English L are not needed in Japanese.

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ לְכ֨וּ וְנַחְשְׁבָ֣ה עַֽל־יִרְמְיָהוּ֮ מַחֲשָׁבוֹת֒ כִּי֩ לֹא־תֹאבַ֨ד תּוֹרָ֜ה מִכֹּהֵ֗ן וְעֵצָה֙ מֵֽחָכָ֔ם וְדָבָ֖ר מִנָּבִ֑יא לְכוּ֙ וְנַכֵּ֣הוּ בַלָּשׁ֔וֹן וְאַל־נַקְשִׁ֖יבָה אֶל־כָּל־דְּבָרָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said, Come and let us devise against Jeremiah plans, for not will perish instruction from [the] priest, and counsel from [the] wise, and [the] word from [the] prophet. Come and let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not pay attention to any of his words.

en.L: Then they said, "Come, and let us devise plans against Jeremiah, for instruction will not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not pay attention to any of his words."
en.B: Then they said, "Come, let us make plans against Jeremiah. Instruction will never be lost to the priest, or counsel to the wise, or the word to the prophet. Come, let us attack him with words and pay no attention to anything he says."
en.R: Then some of the people said, "Come on, let us make plans against Jeremiah. We will still have priests to give us teaching, wise people to give us advice, and prophets to give us God's message. Come, let us attack him with our words. We will not listen to anything he says."

es.L: Entonces dijeron: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, y tramemos planes contra Jeremías, porque no faltará la instrucción al sacerdote, ni el consejo al sabio, ni la palabra al profeta. {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, y hirámoslo con la lengua, y no prestemos atención a ninguna de sus palabras».
es.B: Entonces dijeron: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, hagamos planes contra Jeremías. Nunca faltará la instrucción del sacerdote, ni el consejo del sabio, ni la palabra del profeta. {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, ataquémoslo con palabras y no hagamos caso de nada de lo que diga».
es.R: Entonces algunos del pueblo dijeron: «Vamos, hagamos planes contra Jeremías. Seguiremos teniendo sacerdotes que nos enseñen, sabios que nos aconsejen y profetas que nos den el mensaje de Dios. Vamos, ataquémoslo con nuestras palabras. No escucharemos nada de lo que diga».

fr.L: Alors ils dirent : « Venez, et formons des projets contre Jérémie, car la loi ne se perdra pas chez le prêtre, ni le conseil chez le sage, ni la parole chez le prophète. Venez, et frappons-le avec la langue, et ne prêtons attention à aucune de ses paroles. »
fr.B: Alors ils dirent : « Venez, formons des projets contre Jérémie. L’instruction ne manquera jamais au prêtre, ni le conseil au sage, ni la parole au prophète. Venez, attaquons-le avec des paroles, et ne faisons aucune attention à ce qu’il dit. »
fr.R: Alors certains ont dit : « Venez, faisons des projets contre Jérémie. Nous aurons toujours des prêtres pour nous enseigner, des sages pour nous conseiller et des prophètes pour nous donner le message de Dieu. Venez, attaquons-le avec nos paroles. Nous n’écouterons rien de ce qu’il dit. »

sw.L: Ndipo wakasema, "Njooni, tufanye mipango dhidi ya Yeremia, kwa maana sheria haitapotea kwa kuhani, wala shauri kwa mwenye hekima, wala neno kwa nabii. Njooni, tumpige kwa ulimi, wala tusiyasikilize maneno yake yoyote."
sw.B: Ndipo wakasema, "Njooni, tufanye mipango dhidi ya Yeremia. Mafundisho hayatakosekana kwa kuhani, wala shauri kwa wenye hekima, wala neno kwa nabii. Njooni, tumshambulie kwa maneno, tusijali lolote analosema."
sw.R: Ndipo baadhi ya watu wakasema, "Njooni, tufanye mipango dhidi ya Yeremia. Bado tutakuwa na makuhani wa kutufundisha, wenye hekima wa kutushauri, na manabii wa kutuletea ujumbe wa Mungu. Njooni, tumshambulie kwa maneno yetu. Hatutasikiliza lolote analosema."

vi.L: Bấy giờ chúng nói: "Hãy đến, và chúng ta hãy bày mưu nghịch cùng Giê-rê-mi, vì luật pháp sẽ không mất khỏi thầy tế lễ, mưu lược [không mất] khỏi người khôn ngoan, và lời [không mất] khỏi nhà tiên tri. Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy dùng lưỡi đánh hắn, và đừng để ý đến bất cứ lời nào của hắn."
vi.B: Bấy giờ chúng nói: "Nào, chúng ta hãy bày mưu hại Giê-rê-mi. Thầy tế lễ sẽ không bao giờ thiếu luật pháp, người khôn ngoan không thiếu mưu lược, nhà tiên tri không thiếu lời. Nào, chúng ta hãy dùng lời nói mà tấn công hắn, và đừng để ý gì đến những điều hắn nói."
vi.R: Bấy giờ có người nói: "Nào, chúng ta hãy lập mưu hại Giê-rê-mi. Chúng ta vẫn còn các thầy tế lễ dạy dỗ, những người khôn ngoan khuyên bảo, và các nhà tiên tri truyền sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời. Nào, chúng ta hãy dùng lời nói mà tấn công hắn. Chúng ta sẽ không thèm nghe điều gì hắn nói."

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 말했다. "자, 예레미야를 칠 계획을 꾸미자. 제사장에게서 가르침이, 지혜로운 자에게서 조언이, 예언자에게서 말씀이 끊어지지 않을 것이다. 자, 혀로 그를 치고, 그의 어떤 말에도 귀를 기울이지 말자."
ko.B: 그러자 그들이 말했다. "자, 예레미야를 해칠 계획을 세우자. 제사장에게 가르침이, 지혜로운 사람에게 조언이, 예언자에게 말씀이 없어질 리가 없다. 자, 말로 그를 공격하고, 그가 하는 말에는 조금도 귀를 기울이지 말자."
ko.R: 그러자 몇몇 사람이 말했다. "자, 예레미야를 해칠 계획을 세우자. 우리에게는 여전히 가르침을 줄 제사장들이 있고, 조언을 해 줄 지혜로운 사람들이 있고, 하나님의 말씀을 전해 줄 예언자들이 있다. 자, 말로 그를 공격하자. 그가 하는 말은 하나도 듣지 말자."

pt.L: Então disseram: "Venham, e tramemos planos contra Jeremias, pois não perecerá a instrução do sacerdote, nem o conselho do sábio, nem a palavra do profeta. Venham, e vamos feri-lo com a língua, e não prestemos atenção a nenhuma das suas palavras."
pt.B: Então disseram: "Venham, vamos fazer planos contra Jeremias. A instrução nunca vai faltar ao sacerdote, nem o conselho ao sábio, nem a palavra ao profeta. Venham, vamos atacá-lo com palavras e não dar atenção a nada do que ele diz."
pt.R: Então algumas pessoas disseram: "Venham, vamos fazer planos contra Jeremias. Ainda teremos sacerdotes para nos ensinar, sábios para nos aconselhar e profetas para nos dar a mensagem de Deus. Venham, vamos atacá-lo com as nossas palavras. Não vamos escutar nada do que ele diz."

am.L: እነርሱም፦ «ኑ፣ በኤርምያስ ላይ ዕቅድ እናውጣ፤ ሕግ ከካህን፣ ምክርም ከጠቢብ፣ ቃልም ከነቢይ አይጠፋምና። ኑ፣ በምላስ እንምታው፤ ቃሉንም ሁሉ አናድምጥ» አሉ።
am.B: እነርሱም፦ «ኑ፣ በኤርምያስ ላይ እናሢር። ካህኑ ሕግን፣ ጠቢቡ ምክርን፣ ነቢዩም ቃልን ከቶ አያጡም። ኑ፣ በቃላችን እናጥቃው፤ የሚናገረውንም ሁሉ አንስማ» አሉ።
am.R: ከዚያም አንዳንድ ሰዎች እንዲህ አሉ፦ «ኑ፣ በኤርምያስ ላይ ዕቅድ እናውጣ። ትምህርት የሚሰጡን ካህናት፣ ምክር የሚሰጡን ጠቢባን፣ የእግዚአብሔርንም መልእክት የሚነግሩን ነቢያት አሁንም አሉን። ኑ፣ በቃላችን እናጥቃው። የሚናገረውን ምንም ነገር አንሰማም።»

hi.L: तब उन्होंने कहा, "आओ, हम यिर्मयाह के विरुद्ध युक्तियाँ सोचें, क्योंकि न याजक से शिक्षा, न बुद्धिमान से सम्मति, और न भविष्यद्वक्ता से वचन मिटेगा। आओ, हम उसे जीभ से मारें, और उसकी किसी बात पर ध्यान न दें।"
hi.B: तब उन्होंने कहा, "आओ, हम यिर्मयाह के विरुद्ध योजना बनाएँ। याजक के पास शिक्षा, बुद्धिमान के पास सम्मति, और भविष्यद्वक्ता के पास वचन कभी नहीं मिटेगा। आओ, हम बातों से उस पर वार करें, और उसकी किसी बात पर ध्यान न दें।"
hi.R: तब कुछ लोगों ने कहा, "आओ, हम यिर्मयाह के विरुद्ध योजना बनाएँ। शिक्षा देने के लिए याजक, सलाह देने के लिए बुद्धिमान लोग, और परमेश्वर का संदेश देने के लिए नबी तो हमारे पास रहेंगे ही। आओ, हम अपनी बातों से उस पर हमला करें। वह जो कुछ कहता है, हम उसे नहीं सुनेंगे।"

ru.L: И сказали они: «Придите, и составим замыслы против Иеремии, потому что не исчезнет наставление у священника, и совет у мудрого, и слово у пророка. Придите, и поразим его языком, и не будем внимать никаким его словам.»
ru.B: Тогда они сказали: «Давайте составим замысел против Иеремии. Наставление у священника никогда не исчезнет, и совет у мудрого, и слово у пророка. Давайте нападём на него словами и не будем обращать внимания ни на что, что он говорит.»
ru.R: Тогда некоторые люди сказали: «Давайте придумаем что-нибудь против Иеремии. У нас и так останутся священники, чтобы учить нас, мудрецы, чтобы давать советы, и пророки, чтобы передавать нам слово Бога. Давайте нападём на него словами. Мы не будем слушать ничего из того, что он говорит.»

ja.L: すると、彼らは言った。「さあ、エレミヤに対して計略を巡らそう。祭司から教えが、知恵ある者から助言が、預言者から言葉が、滅びうせることはないからだ。さあ、舌で彼を打とう。彼のどの言葉にも耳を傾けないでおこう。」
ja.B: すると、彼らは言った。「さあ、エレミヤに対して計画を立てよう。祭司から教えが、知恵ある者から助言が、預言者から言葉が失われることは決してない。さあ、言葉で彼を攻撃し、彼の言うことには何一つ耳を貸すまい。」
ja.R: すると、ある人々が言いました。「さあ、エレミヤに対して計画を立てよう。わたしたちには、教えを与えてくれる祭司も、助言をくれる知恵ある人も、神のお告げを伝える預言者も、これからもいる。さあ、言葉であいつを攻撃しよう。あいつの言うことなど、何も聞くものか。」

uk.L: Тоді вони сказали: «Ходімо і задумаймо задуми проти Єремії, бо не загине закон від священника, ні порада від мудрого, ні слово від пророка. Ходімо і вразімо його язиком і не зважаймо на жодне з його слів».
uk.B: Тоді вони сказали: «Ходімо, складімо план проти Єремії. Повчання ніколи не зникне у священника, порада — у мудрого, а слово — у пророка. Ходімо, нападімо на нього словами і не зважаймо на жодне його слово».
uk.R: Тоді дехто з людей сказав: «Ходімо, складімо план проти Єремії. У нас і далі будуть священники, щоб навчати нас, мудрі люди, щоб радити нам, і пророки, щоб передавати нам Боже послання. Ходімо, нападімо на нього нашими словами. Ми не слухатимемо нічого з того, що він каже».

decisions.choice: the start of Jeremiah's fourth lament: the plot against him and his prayer about it
decisions.reason: Verses 18-23 are the fourth of Jeremiah's prayers of complaint to God (11:18-12:6; 15:10-21; 17:14-18; 18:18-23; 20:7-18). Verse 18 tells the plot in prose; in verses 19-23 Jeremiah turns to God in poetry, much as the psalms of lament do.

decisions.choice: they said: Jeremiah's opponents, not named
decisions.reason: The speakers are not named. They are among the people who said they would follow their own plans (verse 12), probably including the priests, wise men and prophets they speak of. Their "plans" against Jeremiah answer God's "plan" against Judah (verse 11).

decisions.choice: instruction from the priest, counsel from the wise, the word from the prophet: the three kinds of guidance Israel relied on
decisions.reason: Priests taught God's instruction, wise men gave advice, and prophets brought God's word (Ezekiel 7:26 names the same three). The plotters mean that they can do without Jeremiah, and that his warnings that these leaders would fail (4:9; 8:8-10) are false.

decisions.choice: strike him with the tongue: attack him with words
alternatives: strike him because of his tongue
decisions.reason: The tongue as a weapon means slander, false charges or a case brought against him in court (9:2, 7; Psalm 64:4). The Hebrew could also be read "strike him for his tongue", that is, because of what he says; either way the attack is aimed at his message.

decisions.choice: let us not pay attention to any of his words: the Hebrew text
alternatives: let us listen closely to all his words
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation has no "not": "and let us listen to all his words", that is, watch what he says so as to catch him out (compare 20:10). The Hebrew text is followed here; both readings describe hostility to Jeremiah's message.

decisions.choice: instruction (Literal, Balanced); teaching (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording settled for this word in the prophets (see Isaiah). Here it is the priests' teaching of God's law.

decisions.choice: some of the people; We will still have priests ...; God's message
decisions.reason: Readable names the speakers loosely, as the Hebrew leaves them unnamed (meaning decision m2), and says what the saying about the priest, the wise and the prophet means.

decisions.choice: la instrucción (Literal, Balanced); que nos enseñen (Readable)
decisions.reason: The priest's *torah* is "instrucción" at Literal and Balanced and teaching at Readable, as the Psalms note sets it.

decisions.choice: sheria (Literal); mafundisho (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili for *torah*: "sheria" at Literal, "mafundisho" (teaching) at Balanced and Readable, as the Psalms note.

decisions.choice: "la loi" (L); "l'instruction" (B); "pour nous enseigner" (R)
decisions.reason: Torah as the Psalms set it in French: "la loi" at Literal, "l'instruction" at Balanced, teaching at Readable.

decisions.choice: "luật pháp" (instruction, torah) at Literal and Balanced; "dạy dỗ" (teach) at Readable
decisions.reason: "Luật pháp" is the published Vietnamese word for torah given by priests; Readable turns it into what the priests do. The opponents speak of Jeremiah as "hắn", which shows their contempt.

decisions.choice: "가르침" for *torah*
decisions.reason: As the Psalms note and the English "instruction": the priest's teaching, not a code of law.

decisions.choice: tramemos planos (L), vamos fazer planos (B, R); tu from verse 19
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's fourth lament begins here (m1): the plot is told in prose, and from verse 19 he speaks to God with "tu" at every level, as in his other laments (11:18). The plotters' "planos" repeat the word of God's "plano" in verse 11 (m2), so the reader can see the two plans set against each other.

decisions.choice: शिक्षा (every level); भविष्यद्वक्ता (L, B), नबी (R)
decisions.reason: Torah from the priest is his teaching: शिक्षा at every level, as the prophets note settles it for torah in the Prophets and as Isaiah has it. The prophet is भविष्यद्वक्ता at Literal and Balanced and नबी at Readable, as the New Testament and earlier books in this translation.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah's fourth lament (verses 18-23)
decisions.reason: Verses 18-23 are Jeremiah's fourth lament (meaning m1): the plot is told in prose, and his prayer from verse 19 is poetry and addresses God with तू, as all prayer in this translation does.

decisions.choice: The prose report that opens the fourth lament (m1): narration plain (L, B), です・ます (R, "言いました"); the plotters speak plainly among themselves ("〜しよう", R "あいつ"); torah "教え", 'etsah "助言", davar "言葉" (L, B) / "神のお告げ" (R) (m3).
decisions.reason: JEREMIAH CONVENTIONS: narrative register; torah 教え in the prophets.
